title: Reminder reliability: inexact alarms; stale-alarm cleanup; time changes; tap-to-open
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the "Mark done" notification action (later item).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- The owner decided to drop exact alarms. `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM` is a special access permission that habit reminders shouldn't need, and Play policy scrutinizes it.
- `importBackup` deletes all trackers and reinserts them with new IDs. `rescheduleReminders` only schedules the new IDs, so the alarms for the old IDs (PendingIntent request code = old ID) still fire with stale names.
- There are no receivers for `ACTION_TIME_CHANGED`/`ACTION_TIMEZONE_CHANGED`, so reminders drift after travel or manual clock changes.
- The notification has no `contentIntent`, so tapping it does nothing.
- It fires even when the tracker is already satisfied for today.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `nextReminderTrigger` tests from S02 still pass.
- Add a JVM test for the new pure `shouldNotify(bundle, today)`: false when today's target is met, true otherwise.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Remove `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM` and its comment from the manifest. Delete `canScheduleExactAlarms` and the exact branch; always call `setAndAllowWhileIdle`.
2. Stale alarms:
   - Before the import transaction, read the existing tracker IDs and call `cancelTracker` for each.
   - Call `cancelTracker` on archive and on delete (S15).
   - Add `cancelAll(ids)`.
3. Extend `ReminderBootReceiver` with `ACTION_TIME_CHANGED`, `ACTION_TIMEZONE_CHANGED`, and `ACTION_LOCALE_CHANGED`, and add the matching manifest intent-filter actions.
4. Add `setContentIntent(PendingIntent.getActivity(..., Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).putExtra(EXTRA_TRACKER_ID, id), FLAG_IMMUTABLE|FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT))`. Handle the extra in `MainActivity.onCreate/onNewIntent` by calling `viewModel.select(id)` (from S07). Use `launchMode="singleTop"`.
5. Add `shouldNotify`: the receiver loads the bundle and skips the notification if `TrackerAnalytics` reports today satisfied. Use a YES_NO entry today, or a daily COUNT at or above target. For weekly targets, always notify.
6. Replace the stock `ic_popup_reminder` small icon with a monochrome vector app glyph from S13. Until S13 lands, use a placeholder vector.
7. Update DEVELOPERS.md: reminders are inexact and may arrive a few minutes late.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Manual: set a reminder 2 minutes out → it arrives, and tapping it opens that tracker.
- Import a backup → the old reminders don't fire.
- Change the timezone → the reminder fires at the new local time.
- Log a yes/no tracker today → no notification.
- `aapt dump permissions` (or the merged manifest) has no `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM`.
